patches.description: Fix --orphans-only flag to emit one-line summaries of tracker_only and mentioned_only buckets before returning. Previously the flag exited without reporting these buckets, silently hiding potential lost deliverables (tracker_only: tracker entry but no file). Now emits: 'TRACKER-ONLY (no file, benign reservation drift): N' and 'MENTIONED-ONLY (cross-referenced, no standalone record): N' if non-zero.
